text: Understand the proposed online auction procedure.

The proposed networked version uses ten fixed category positions and a finite supply of cards. Seven positions correspond to capability or accessory areas and three correspond to engineering-process cards. An initial bidding preset begins at a card's listed opening amount and uses $50,000 increases. These specifics belong to the proposed digital version.

items: The proposed online flow limits each team to two purchases per round. It excludes resale, automatic raises and unbought-card recycling.

text: Publish the selected rules and their revision before participants begin bidding.
Do not assume the earlier workshop exercise used these particular tie or bid rules.
